# wave10: the unwind-climb closure, THUNK-AWARE and depth-bounded.
#
# wave9 walked callers of 0x50d180 but EVERY caller actually calls the
# one-instruction thunk 0x4c4430 (`jmp 0x50d180`), so the backward closure
# stopped at the thunk and missed 0x5d2dec (dofile, just after its
# lua_pcall) — the hop-2 failure. A jmp-thunk is a hole in ANY backward
# call-graph walk. This one follows them.
#
# ⚠️ BOUNDED COVERAGE, stated rather than silent: depth 5 = 1266 addresses.
# The closure grows 4x per level after that (depth 6 = 5690, depth 8 =
# 17071 = most of the image), so this is a deliberate cut, not the whole
# set. The console's own chain needs depth 3; the rest is headroom for the
# frontend's own error paths. A deeper unwind will still report
# '[unwind] NO LIFTED BLOCK' — that message is the instrument, and it is
# not silent.
